rule_or_step_title: Negative Discriminators: Features Arguing Against KDM6B Etiology
matching_criterion_description: Affected patients do not exhibit phocomelia, ectrodactyly, or intercalary limb reductions.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Discriminators: Features Arguing Against KDM6B Etiology
phenotype_name: Fifth Digit Distal Phalanx or Nail Aplasia/Hypoplasia
matching_criterion_description: Severe hypoplasia or anonychia of the fifth digit characteristic of Coffin-Siris syndrome is absent in Stolerman syndrome cohorts.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Discriminators: Features Arguing Against KDM6B Etiology
matching_criterion_description: Absence of anterior segment dysgenesis or structural corneal clouding differentiates Stolerman syndrome from storage diseases and severe anterior chamber cleavage disorders.

rule_or_step_title: Negative Discriminators: Features Arguing Against KDM6B Etiology
phenotype_name: Profound Prenatal Microcephaly with Intrauterine Dwarfism
matching_criterion_description: Stolerman syndrome is not characterized by severe primordial microcephalic dwarfism.
